name: Projection-Conditioning Closure Calculus
statement: For every family $\mathcal F$ in an operation-stable ambient universe, $\operatorname{Cl}_{pc}(\mathcal F)=\operatorname{Cl}_c(\operatorname{Cl}_p(\mathcal F))=\operatorname{Cl}_p(\operatorname{Cl}_c(\mathcal F))$. If $\mathcal F$ is p-closed, then $\operatorname{Cl}_{pc}(\mathcal F)=\operatorname{Cl}_c(\mathcal F)$. If it is pc-closed, then $\operatorname{Obs}_{pc}(\mathcal F)=\operatorname{Obs}_p(\mathcal F)\cap\operatorname{Obs}_c(\mathcal F)$.
proof: The pc-minor normal form permits all projected coordinates to be removed before or after all conditioned coordinates. For the obstruction identity, pc-minimality implies both restricted minimalities. Conversely, the first effective step of a proper mixed minor lies in the pc-closed family by either restricted minimality, and closure keeps every later step inside.
